body.heading: Write your letters
paragraphs: Fold a small piece of paper. Draw or write something kind inside for someone in your family.
Stick a sticker in the corner as a stamp and write their name on the front.

body.heading: Deliver the post
paragraphs: Put the letters in your post bag and deliver them one by one, knocking politely at each door or chair.
Watch the faces when your letters arrive. Post people bring smiles.

takeaway: A letter is a hug you can hold in your hand.
safetyNotes: Deliver letters only inside your home, to people who are happy to receive them.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a postcard from a place you dream of visiting and post it to the fridge.
